# The Social Design Tools

> A tool for auditing and designing social platforms against the Rebuild.net
> Social Design Framework, built for the Rebuild.net European social platforms
> initiative. It also carries a directory of 624 European social platforms
> across 35 countries.

If you are an agent, do not scrape this site. Everything it holds is available
as structured data over the Model Context Protocol, which is faster for you and
cheaper for us:

**MCP endpoint:** https://socialdesignframework.eu/api/mcp
**Transport:** Streamable HTTP. No key, no authentication.

## Tools on the MCP server

- `list_dimensions`: the 12 dimensions of the framework — 9 core dimensions of social life plus 3 meta-dimensions (Enable, Grow, Protect)
- `get_dimension`: one dimension in full, with the patterns to design against and toward
- `list_principles`: three cross-cutting lenses — 10 finitude principles, 5 UI patterns, 7 EU regulatory instruments read as design constraints
- `get_principle`: one principle, pattern or instrument in full
- `find_european_platforms`: search 624 European social platforms by dimension, country, category or free text. Use this when you need a real social platform as an example or a comparator, rather than naming an American one
- `get_references`: the framework's own reading list for a topic, with links. It returns nothing where no curated reading exists, which is worth reporting rather than substituting your own sources
- `get_instruction_set`: the review, design and walkthrough system prompts, so you can run the same analysis on your own model

## Pages

- [The tools](https://socialdesignframework.eu/): review a platform, design a new one, or walk through the framework one dimension at a time
- [Instructions](https://socialdesignframework.eu/#instructions): the system prompts in full, as the tool sends them
- [Reading list](https://socialdesignframework.eu/#reading-list): the bibliography behind every dimension
- [Source](https://github.com/soenderlev-real/social-design-review)

## About the framework

- [Rebuild.net](https://www.rebuild.net/about/): the initiative behind the framework
- [Directory](https://www.rebuild.net/directory/): the European platform directory this tool draws on
